about: Gate 200 (TC-R300): on Scholar's Mate, in the started Review, every grade mark of the eval graph (its 24px hit circle, and its painted shape on both axes) lies inside the graph svg's own box, and a hit test at the last mark's centre reaches that mark. Graded at 375x761 (his phone), 320x568 and 844x390. NOT COVERED: the graph in the summary's hidden Review, the sideways Play graph (landGraph) and the Analyze-board graph, which share EvalGraph and so the fix but are not driven here; games with more than two marks (the gate pins geometry of whatever marks there are, at least two); his look on the phone.

breaks.name: graph-no-viewbox
breaks.why: the svg loses its viewBox again, so when its box is narrower than the width it was asked for the drawing is clipped, not shrunk - the defect as found

breaks.name: graph-no-edge-inset
breaks.why: the first and last ply sit on x=0 and x=width again, so half of each 24px tap circle hangs past the svg edge

breaks.name: graph-no-vertical-pad
breaks.why: the vertical pad shrinks to 1px, so a mark at a clamped evaluation (the mate) paints past the top edge
